issue_context.title: Media information not populated in webhook events for content
issue_context.body: ## Bug report ### Required System information - Node.js version: v20.16.0 - NPM version: 10.8.1 - Strapi version: 5.0.0 - Database: sqlite - Operating system: MacOS (darwin-arm64) - Is your project Javascript or Typescript: Typescript ### Describe the bug - Media information/properties are not populated inside webhook events for content (e.g., when creating/updating content). - In Strapi V4, for media fields, we used to receive the full record for the media within the webhook event when the content is was attached to was created/updated. However, in Strapi V5, we only recieve the media's Asset ID and nothing else. - This screenshot shows what we receieve in webhook events for content with media (in this case a create event). As you can see, we only receive the media ID: - Interestingly, the media information is populated for `entry.delete` events: We use S3 as our upload provider, and want to perform some actions on the media in response to it being attached to content. However, as the media is stored using the filename, unless this information is in the webhook, its not possible to know which piece of media we need to work with. ### Steps to reproduce the behavior - Setup a new webhook for content create/update/delete - Create a content type with a media field - Create a new piece of content with a piece of media attached to it - Inspect the payload on the webhook event - there will be no informaiton on the media other than the media ID. ### Expected behavior - The full set of media information should be populated on all content webhook events, as can be seen in this example:
comments:
related to: https://docs.strapi.io/dev-docs/migration/v4-to-v5/breaking-changes/remove-webhook-populate-relations

Need to discuss with engineering what was intended here

Thanks - Yup relates to that change. Weirdly enough for non-media relations (i.e., other content), the data is properly populated, but it seems like thats now broken the population for media relations.

In case anyone else is facing this issue, as a work around, I have defined by 'own' webhooks within lifecycle hooks for the DB  👍
